serverSettings.title: Server settings
serverSettings.defaultLanguageHint: Used for server-rendered pages without a signed-in user, such as the invite link page.
serverSettings.storeUrlsHint: Optional. If set, the invite link page shows download buttons for people who don't have the app yet. Leave blank to hide them.
serverSettings.dataExportDesc: Download a zip of all family content — posts, comments, reactions, poll votes, favorites, chat messages, circles, the member list, and every uploaded photo/video. It can be restored onto a new, empty Famlin server from its first-run setup screen. Server configuration and secrets (SMTP, OIDC, Immich, passwords, invite links, tokens) are never included.
serverSettings.appleBundleIdsHint: Sign in with Apple works out of the box and needs no setup — leave this blank. Only fill it in if you distribute your own iOS build: list its bundle identifier (comma-separated for several) so this server accepts Sign in with Apple tokens issued to it. The official app's bundle ID is always accepted.
serverSettings.oidcClientSecretHint: Only needed for providers that reject a secretless PKCE exchange, such as Google. Leave blank for providers like Authentik/Keycloak/Auth0 that support a public/native client. When set, Famlin exchanges the authorization code on the backend instead of in the browser or app.
serverSettings.oidcHint: Works with any OpenID Connect provider (Google, Microsoft, Authentik, Keycloak, Auth0, ...). Register Famlin as a public/native client with PKCE and add this app's redirect URIs.
serverSettings.allowedEmailsHint: Comma-separated. SSO sign-ins are limited to these addresses; leave empty to allow everyone. Invite links always work regardless of this list.
serverSettings.pushHint: Sent via Expo's push relay (no Apple/Google credentials needed on your server). Turn off if you don't want the server to send push notifications at all — in-app and email notifications are unaffected.
serverSettings.emailHint: Turn off if you don't want the server to send email notifications at all — in-app and push notifications are unaffected.
serverSettings.integrationsHint: Each media source is configured once for the whole instance; which albums are visible to which group is linked from the Groups page. Members can then pick photos from a linked album when composing a post.
serverSettings.immichHint: Configure one Immich server + API key. Recommended API key permissions: album.read, asset.read, asset.view, asset.download.
serverSettings.immichTestUnauthorized: Connected, but the API key was rejected.
serverSettings.immichTestUnreachable: Could not reach the Immich server.
serverSettings.localMediaHint: Serve photos straight from a directory on this server (e.g. a NAS share mounted into the container). Every subdirectory of the path becomes a linkable album; only image files are listed.
serverSettings.localMediaTestNotFound: Path not found or not readable from the server.
serverSettings.localMediaTestNotADirectory: Path exists but is not a directory.
serverSettings.backupsDesc: Scheduled backups of the database and every uploaded photo and video, written to the backups volume on this server.
serverSettings.backupEnabledHint: Off until you turn it on. Each run makes a database dump and updates one incremental copy of the uploads.
serverSettings.backupHint: Uploads are mirrored incrementally rather than copied each time. Files deleted from Famlin stay in the mirror for 30 days before they are removed. Admins get an email if a backup fails or none has succeeded for twice the schedule interval (needs SMTP).
serverSettings.backupStatusLink: See backup status and run a backup now
serverSettings.backupIncludeMediaHint: When disabled, only the database and branding are backed up. The existing media mirror is retained.
serverSettings.exportIncludeMediaHint: When disabled, restore requires all listed media to be present in configured storage. Branding is always included.

peopleMapping.title: People mapping
peopleMapping.hint: Map people detected in your photos to family members so they appear with their names in the family feed. Only mapped people become visible to family members.
peopleMapping.notConfigured: Immich is not configured yet. Fill in the server URL and API key above and save to map people.
peopleMapping.noPeople: No people found in your Immich library.
peopleMapping.userMappingHint: If set, this person's photos will be tagged with their Famlin profile. Leave empty to show the display name only.
peopleMapping.mergeHint: This label already exists — this person will be merged with "{{label}}".

circles.hint: Circles let part of a family share privately. Members outside a circle never see its posts, photos or comments — and never learn it exists.
circles.noMembers: No one in this circle yet.
circles.confirmDeleteWithPosts: Delete the circle "{{name}}"? This permanently deletes its {{count}} post(s) and everything on them. You cannot see or recover this content afterwards.

branding.title: Branding
branding.desc: Give this Famlin server your family's own look in the mobile and web apps.
branding.publicNote: The logo and family name are visible to anyone who opens this server's address.
branding.name: Family name
branding.nameHint: Shown in the app header and on the login screen, and used as the title of push notifications and emails. Leave empty to keep "Famlin".
branding.adjusted: {{from}} is too light for white text, so it's darkened to {{to}} to stay readable.
branding.shifted: So they stay distinguishable from your brand color, these post colors change too: {{families}}.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. A square image works best. Also used as the web app's browser icon.
branding.appliesHint: Mobile apps pick up a change the next time they're started.

backups.notMounted: The backups folder isn't a mounted volume, so backups are lost when the container is recreated. Add the famlin-backups volume to your docker-compose.yml.

disk.title: Disk space
disk.sameVolume: Backups are on the same volume as the uploads. A separate disk or NAS share protects against losing both at once.
